title: Re-deliver preflight implementation-surface enforcement
outOfScope: Retroactively modifying #683 or any archived Work Item evidence.
Changing unrelated runtime governance, hosted workflows, branch protection, or release policy.
Allowing post-before_edit Contract repair or bypassing restricted-write approval.

sources.reason: Authoritative successor scope and acceptance for the blocked #683 delivery.
Original P1 problem statement and preflight boundary requirements.
Canonical Contract schema validator that must own implementation-surface validation.
Preflight evidence projection that must expose a blocking implementation-surface signal.
Current lifecycle documentation and no-post-freeze-repair boundary.
Current-main Contract evidence pattern after predecessor closure.

riskAssessment.reason: The change controls whether Work Items are permitted to modify governance runtime, guard, test, and documentation paths before the immutable before_edit checkpoint.
riskAssessment.unknownsReviewReason: The original #683 report, scope-complete successor #685, current schema validator, and preflight entrypoint provide sufficient concrete acceptance and test targets.

reasons: This is a P1 governance and restricted-write enforcement change whose failure would allow a false implementation-ready state.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized the complete remediation plan and instructed that recurring workflow defects be corrected through governed Work Items rather than temporary workarounds.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Freeze the complete runtime, test, guard, template, and documentation surface before implementation and before archive.

acceptance: A future MODE=code Contract can declare implementationSurface with concrete production, tests, generated, and documentation path lists; malformed or unknown surface fields fail closed.
Before implementation, every declared implementation-surface path is covered by Contract scope and not covered by outOfScope; a planned production surface requires at least one planned test path.
A restricted Makefile, guard, or other policy-matched surface is rejected unless restrictedWriteApproval is complete; no post-before_edit repair path is accepted.
ai-preflight and ai-prepare-implementation block on an invalid implementation surface, while ai-start continues to show the advisory Preflight review for a new skeleton.
Red-first regressions cover omitted runtime, test, Makefile, and guard paths and a valid fully declared surface; installed Makefile and lifecycle documentation expose the same boundary.
guidelines: Keep the Contract schema validator as the single source of implementation-surface validation; do not add a parallel Finish-only check.
Treat a restricted surface as an approval requirement even when its broad scope pattern matches.
Do not weaken ai-start's skeleton behavior, ai-preflight's fail-closed implementation boundary, or ai-prepare-implementation's before_edit checkpoint.
Keep source Makefile, installed Makefile, tests, generated capability evidence, and lifecycle documentation aligned.

intent.problem: Work Items can pass the initial Preflight and freeze before_edit, then fail only at Finish because an implementation-required Makefile, guard, runtime, test, or documentation path was omitted from scope or lacked restricted-write approval. The immutable checkpoint correctly prevents late repair, but the defect creates avoidable successor churn.
constraints: Preserve readability of historic Contracts and immutable #683 evidence.
Enforce new implementation-surface evidence before before_edit rather than repairing it after verification starts.
Use one structured field with concrete paths and validate it against scope, outOfScope, test coverage, and restricted-write policy.
Keep ai-start usable for skeleton creation while ai-preflight and ai-prepare-implementation remain blocking for implementation.
intent.rationale: Making the required implementation surface explicit and machine-checked before editing converts a late ownership failure into an actionable, fail-closed pre-edit decision and prevents unnecessary successor Work Items.

declaredIntent.summary: Enforce a scope-complete, approval-aware implementation surface before a Work Item can enter implementation.

rawUserRequest: 目标：执行计划，到全部完成。我授权给你自动执行，写入到每个工单的Contract里。遇到流程问题，要先开工单修正，不要采用临时修补方案。全部原始指摘不得遗漏；最终执行自检、修正循环和发布。

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A Contract plans a runtime implementation path and its regression test.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Preflight accepts only when both concrete paths are declared in implementationSurface and covered by scope.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Unit and preflight regressions for valid and omitted runtime/test paths.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A Contract plans a Makefile or guard-policy change.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Preflight blocks unless restrictedWriteApproval is complete and the path is declared in the surface and scope.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Red-first validator and preflight regressions for Makefile and guard omissions and approval states.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: An invalid planned implementation surface reaches ai-preflight or ai-prepare-implementation.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Both commands fail before before_edit evidence is written, while ai-start remains able to create an advisory skeleton.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Makefile command wiring regression and no-checkpoint assertion.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user explicitly authorized automatic execution of every planned remediation Work Item and required recurring process defects to be corrected in governed Work Items; this Contract declares its restricted Makefile and governance paths before before_edit.

rollbackNote: Revert the schema, Preflight, Makefile, template, documentation, and regression changes together; the previous behavior remains intact without rewriting archived #683 evidence.
